verdict.rationale: Docs show a single conversion API/SDK handling PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, and images into Markdown/HTML/JSON without per-format code paths (datalab-docs-17, datalab-docs-22, datalab-probe-rt-1), which covers most of the story's format list. However, there is no explicit mention of PPTX or email as supported input formats in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: PPTX support, email format support, and independent confirmation that all formats route through one unchanged API call.
